payload.title: Inventory: which feedback behaviour is generic and which is Shipped-specific
payload.description:
What: list each reader feature as generic (Vote, Rating, Comments, Flag, ReaderSignIn, Freshness, Proposals voting) or Shipped-specific (the four dimensions useful/ready/advances/open and their questions in web/scoring.json, vote subject types item/submission/story/proposal mirrored from papyrus.config.ts, UsedIt, verdicts, Underrated). Generic ones go to Papyrus as block options; specific ones stay as site configuration, not code. Output is a table on this issue; no code.
Acceptance:
Scenario: Every island call site is classified
  Given the nine _island() call sites in web/hooks.py
  Then each is marked generic or Shipped-specific with the Papyrus story that takes it
